metadata.architecture: single-layer pre-normalized four-head causal attention-only decoder with a twelve-dimensional residual stream, non-affine RMS normalization, and sinusoidal positions
metadata.author: declarative architecture search
metadata.mechanism_hypothesis: A twelve-dimensional residual stream with four three-dimensional attention heads should retain the parent's causal alignment behavior while eliminating width coordinates not supported by any public arithmetic benefit.
metadata.name: Width-12 Single-Attention Addition Decoder
metadata.research_alternative_explanation: The token, position, and attention features required for the public eligibility floor may fit in twelve dimensions, making four dimensions of the parent redundant.
metadata.research_challenged_assumption: The current direction implicitly treats a sixteen-dimensional residual stream as necessary for causal digit alignment and carry-relevant representations despite zero public accuracy.
metadata.research_current_explanation: The non-affine attention-only parent is compact and valid, but its zero public score gives no evidence that all sixteen residual dimensions are useful.
metadata.research_decision_rule: Retain the child only if it is valid, satisfies the frozen public eligibility floor, and has fewer trusted parameters; use public accuracy only for an exact parameter-count tie.
metadata.research_discriminating_evidence: Eligibility retained after width reduction favors representational redundancy and further compression; a validity or robustness-floor failure favors sixteen dimensions as necessary capacity.
metadata.research_evidence: The current sixteen-dimensional parent has 1264 trusted parameters and a public search score of 0.0.
metadata.research_expected_result: Reducing the residual width to twelve while retaining four causal heads should preserve eligibility and substantially lower the trusted parameter count.
metadata.research_next_experiment: Reduce every hidden representation from sixteen to twelve dimensions while preserving four-head attention, topology, normalization, positions, and tied readout.
metadata.research_previous_interpretation: Removing affine RMS-normalization parameters reduced the trusted count from 1296 to 1264, while public accuracy remained 0.0.
